# Connect MCP in seconds

Link your AI client to lomi. so it can create checkouts, list payments, and debug webhooks for your organization, without pasting an API key.

<McpOauthConnect />

## What happens

1. Click a button above for your client.
2. Your client opens **Connect with lomi.** in the browser.
3. Sign in (or create an account), choose your organization, and approve access.
4. Merchant tools are available in that client right away.

Agents without a lomi. account yet can start on the guest endpoint and provision a sandbox key first; see the full [MCP guide](/build/mcp) for that path and deeper setup.

For authentication options, hosted URLs, and the full tool catalog, continue in [MCP for AI clients](/build/mcp).
